name: fibbers-storybook
description: Storybook showcase for the Fibbers Home Assistant cards — hosted on GitHub Pages.

scripts.test-storybook:ci: npm run build-storybook && npm run test-storybook:static
scripts.test-storybook:static: concurrently -k -s first -n SB,TEST "http-server storybook-static -p 6017 -s" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:6017 && test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6017 --testTimeout 30000"
